a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly leaves us both dead after round 1. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough for one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1 instead of following the original plan. I'm telling you so you can decide with full information. If you'd rather propose something else, I'm listening.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said before the round, I'm taking 4 now. If there's no storm, I'll keep operating with you so you can get your 4 cells. I'll operate every round from here on to help refill the reserve for you.
